descriptions.home_base: Launch pad, charging pad and the kit depot. A hangar: storms never close it.
descriptions.trailhead: Car park and the trail's first bend; open gravel.
descriptions.lower_creek: The creek runs into a gorge; steep banks.
descriptions.creek_mouth: Marshy flats where the creek leaves the valley.
descriptions.west_woods: Dense mixed woods; the canopy hides the ground.
descriptions.r1: Open grass, good visibility. The trail crosses it.
descriptions.r2: Rocky creek bed; the phone's last ping. Grey boulders look like people from above.
descriptions.boulder_field: Jumbled boulders east of the creek.
descriptions.nofly_power: High-voltage line. Never cross it; go around its west end.
descriptions.fire_scrub: Dry scrub; fire crews may close it.
descriptions.saddle: Grassy saddle between the meadow and the ridge; the forward swap station.
descriptions.r3: Steep slope with a stand of tall pines; the likeliest place to fall.
descriptions.east_ridge: Exposed ridge; storms come in from here.
descriptions.west_ridge: Dry ridge top above the scrub.
descriptions.r4: Clearing on the ridge with a campsite.
